     1	import dlt
     2	from pyspark.sql.functions import col, current_timestamp
     3	from pyspark.sql.types import *
     4	from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

     6	spark = SparkSession.getActiveSession()
     7	catalog = spark.conf.get("catalog")
     8	pipeline_schema = spark.conf.get("pipeline_schema")
     9	volume = spark.conf.get("volume")
    10	file_path = f"/Volumes/{catalog}/{pipeline_schema}/{volume}/consumer_order_items/"

    12	# Explicit schema from metadata_consumer_order_items.json
    13	schema = StructType([
    14	    StructField("order_item_id", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    15	    StructField("order_id", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    16	    StructField("product_id", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    17	    StructField("quantity", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    18	    StructField("unit_price", DoubleType(), nullable=False),
    19	    StructField("total_price", DoubleType(), nullable=False),
    20	    StructField("operation", StringType(), nullable=False)
    21	])
    22	
    23	@dlt.view(name="raw_consumer_order_items")
    24	def raw_consumer_order_items():
    25	    df = spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles") \
    26	        .option("cloudFiles.format", "json") \
    27	        .option("multiline", "true") \
    28	        .schema(schema) \
    29	        .load(file_path)
    30	    return df.withColumn("ingestion_time", current_timestamp())
    31	
    32	dlt.create_streaming_table("consumer_order_items_cdc_stream")
    33	
    34	dlt.apply_changes(
    35	    target="consumer_order_items_cdc_stream",
    36	    source=dlt.read("raw_consumer_order_items"),
    37	    keys=["order_item_id"],
    38	    sequence_by=col("ingestion_time"),
    39	    apply_as_deletes=col("operation") == "delete",
    40	    except_column_list=["operation", "ingestion_time"],
    41	    stored_as_scd_type=2
